description: Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development - Declare the Area called "Dedigama Kotawehera Raja Maha Vihara Sacred Area" as an Urban Development Area
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically declaring the "Dadigama Kotavehera Raja Maha Vihara sacred Area" as an urban development area under the Town and Country Planning Ordinance. It includes detailed land descriptions, boundaries, lot numbers, and survey information, making it clearly focused on land and property-related matters rather than government personnel or structure.
